fact: Delegates from South Africa took part in the SADC Regional Workshop on Data Governance in the Digital Age in Harare, hosted by Zimbabwe's ICT ministry on data policy harmonisation; the document gives no event date, so the published date 2026-08-13 is used.
South Africa's Vote 30 lists a 2026/27 multilateral membership transfer of R2,073 thousand to the African Telecommunications Union, appropriated on 2026-02-25.

South Africa hosted and chaired the 46th Ordinary SADC Summit in eThekwini, closing it on 17 August 2026 with a chairship priority of One-Stop Border Posts and digitised border systems; the article is dated 18 August.
South Africa's Department of Science, Technology and Innovation was a named launching partner of AUDA-NEPAD's Africa Semiconductor Technical Advisory Group, launched from Midrand on 16 July 2026.
